# TEST_ONLY multilingual fixtures

This is an artificial workspace with 25 Vietnamese-English query pairs and five categories. It is not live knowledge or evidence about the real projects.

English body text remains unchanged during search; Vietnamese phrases exist only as metadata or queries. The fixture registry is separate from the live manifest. Missing IDs, files and pointers are intentional negative cases. The legacy page has no new multilingual metadata.

Run the validation runner from the real workspace root. It records actual results for both languages, expected outcomes, expansions, scopes and source pointers. Do not ingest these files into the live wiki.
